title: Chromatin immunoprecipitation from _C. elegans_ embryos
protocol: Use standard worm growing techniques.
Grow worms on 10-20 10 cm plates.
Starve the worms on the plates.
Add concentrated _E. Coli_ (HB101 or OP50) grown to saturation and resuspended in M9+20% glycerol at equal weight:volume ratio.
Bleach the worms as described previously to obtain embryos.
Transfer embryos to 500 ml liquid media (S medium+1X PSN antibiotics and nystatin).
Grow at 20 °C in an incubator shaking at 100 rpm.
Add concentrated _E. Coli_ for food during growth.
Collect adults by filtration over a 35 μm nitex membrane.
Transfer collected worms to 50 ml conical tubes.
Mix 10 ml of worms with 40 ml bleaching solution for 8-12 minutes while monitoring bleaching process.
Spin down embryos at 3000 g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the pellet (embryos) in 50 ml M9 and spin again at 3000 g for 5 minutes.
Repeat washing with M9 solution two more times.
Resuspend embryos in 47 ml of M9.
Add 2.8 ml of 37% formaldehyde solution to the resuspended embryos.
Place on a shaker (50-100 rpm) and incubate for 30 minutes at room temperature (between 22-26 °C).
Wash embryos once with 50 ml of 100 mM Tris pH 7.5.
Wash embryos twice with 50 ml of M9 buffer.
Wash embryos once with 10 ml of FA buffer supplemented with protease inhibitors.
Collect embryos in microfuge tubes by centrifugation at 13,000 g for 30 seconds.
Discard supernatant and store the embryo pellet at -80°C.
Resuspend 500 μl of packed embryos in 1.5 ml of FA buffer with protease inhibitors.
Dounce resuspended embryos on ice using a glass dounce homogenizer pestle B for 30 strokes.
Transfer homogenized sample to a 15 ml tube and bring the volume to 2 ml with FA buffer containing protease inhibitors.
Sonicate samples on ice at 30% amplitude, 0.9 seconds on, 0.1 seconds off, for 12 pulses repeated seven times.
Cool samples in dry ice/ethanol bath for 2 seconds after each sonication cycle.
Transfer sonicated samples to microfuge tubes and spin at 13,000 g for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Take the supernatant and discard the pellet.
Determine the protein concentration of the supernatant by the Bradford method.
Continue with the next step or aliquot and snap freeze in liquid nitrogen.
Store aliquots at -80°C.
Add extract corresponding to ~3.3 mg of protein to a microfuge tube.
Bring the volume to 500 μl with FA buffer + protease inhibitors.
Add 25 μl of 20% sarkosyl solution and spin at 13,000 g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Transfer the supernatant to a new tube.
Remove 10% of the material and store it at -20°C until the following day.
Add 20-30 μg protein A-purified antibody or 3-5 μg affinity-purified antibody to the extract.
Rotate the mixture at 4°C for 16-20 hours.
Take 20 μl of protein A-sepharose beads per ChIP sample and wash with 4 times with 1 ml FA buffer.
Spin at 2500 g for 2 minutes to collect the beads after each wash.
Suspend the beads in one bed volume of FA buffer.
Add 40 μl of bead slurry to each ChIP sample.
Rotate the mixture at 4°C for 2 hours.
Wash beads with 1 ml FA buffer twice, incubating for 5 minutes each time at room temperature on a nutator or rotator.
Collect beads by spinning for 2 minutes at 2500 g.
Wash beads once with 1 ml FA-1 M NaCl for 5 minutes and transfer to new tubes.
Wash beads once with 1 ml FA-500 mM NaCl for 10 minutes and transfer to new tubes.
Wash beads twice with 1 ml TEL buffer for 10 minutes each at room temperature on a nutator or rotator, collecting by spinning for 2 minutes at 2500 g after each wash.
Wash beads twice with 1 ml TE buffer for 5 minutes each at room temperature on a nutator or rotator, collecting by spinning for 2 minutes at 2500 g after each wash.
To elute the immunocomplexes.
Add 150 μl Elution Buffer to the tube.
Place the tube in a 65°C heat block for 15 min.
Vortex briefly every 5 min.
Spin down the beads at 2500 g for 2 min.
Transfer the supernatant to a new tube.
Repeat elution and combine supernatants.
Thaw input samples set aside the previous day.
Add 250 μl Elution Buffer to each sample.
Incubate for 1-2 hours at 55°C.
Transfer samples to 65°C for 12-20 h to reverse crosslinks.
Purify DNA with Qiaquick PCR purification kit.
Elute with 50 μl H2O.
Run 5 μl of input DNA on a 1.5% agarose gel.
Add 25 μl ChIP DNA or 2.5 μl input DNA diluted to 25 μl with dH2O to a PCR tube.
Include a negative control by preparing a reaction with no DNA.
Add H2O, 10X NEB buffer, BSA, dNTP mix, and T4 DNA polymerase to the blunting mix.
Mix by pipetting.
Incubate at 12°C for 20 min in a PCR machine.
Purify DNA on a Zymo column.
Elute in 25 μl H2O and place on ice.
Add 13 μl H₂O to each sample.
Add 5 μl 10X ligase buffer to each sample.
Add 6.7 μl annealed linkers (15 uM) to each sample.
Add 0.5 μl T4 DNA ligase to each sample.
Incubate the samples at 16°C for 12-20 hours.
Purify the ligated DNA using a Zymo column and elute in 15 μl H₂O.
Transfer the purified DNA to a PCR tube and place on ice.
Mix 62.7 μl H₂O, 10 μl 10X PCR buffer (no MgCl₂), 8 μl MgCl₂ (25 mM), 0.8 μl dNTPs (25 mM each), 2.5 μl oligo Long (40 uM), and 1 μl Taq DNA Polymerase (5u/ul) for PCR.
Add 85 μl of the PCR mix to each sample.
Incubate at 55°C for 4 minutes.
Incubate at 72°C for 5 minutes.
Incubate at 95°C for 2 minutes.
Repeat steps: Incubate at 95°C for 30 seconds, then 55°C for 30 seconds, and finally 72°C for 1 minute. Repeat this cycle 24-28 times.
Incubate at 72°C for 4 minutes.
Cool to 4°C.
Purify the amplified DNA using a Qiaquick PCR purification kit and elute in 50 μl dH₂O.
Load 5 μl of the purified DNA on a 1.5% agarose gel to check amplification.
Check that the size of the amplified DNA is between 200-600 bp.
